column1: # Marker data of tools/sweep-score. Data, not code: it grows here. Tab separated: kind <TAB> value.
# Matching is case-insensitive substring on the page's visible text (the render dump's `text`, or the log text
# when there is no dump). Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# kind `param`  : a number the rules use (name <TAB> value is carried in the value column as `name=value`).
# kind `consent`, `bot`, `login` : wall markers. A page is only `walled` when a marker matches AND the page
#                 has a small visible-text amount (param wall_max_text_chars; with no dump, wall_max_log_bytes).
# kind `error`  : text of the engine's own error page. It makes the page `broken`, never `walled`.
# A marker needs to be a phrase a content page almost never contains; a long article that mentions
# "captcha" is not a wall, which is why the text-size limit exists.
